opportunity.action_idea: A daily job compares allocated meter volumes against active Sitara deal tickets and flags each meter with flow but no matching or unexpired deal, pre-filling the counterparty, meter, month and volume into a request to the deal owner. The deal owner still decides whether to extend, create a new deal, or sign off a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
opportunity.description: Volume management, settlements or schedulers find gas flowing at a meter with no valid Sitara deal (missing, expired, wrong counterparty) and ask the deal owner to create, extend or correct the ticket, or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
opportunity.formula: 311 messages / 25.84 months observed (farmer-d, giron-d) = 12.04/month; x 20 min median handling x 60% automatable = 2.4 h/month; x $85/h = $205/month
opportunity.name: Missing or expired deal tickets for metered flow
